evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B02NbDxp3 ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09B7SB46R?...plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven ...)

evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B00hJ57DV ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DKYBTPH?...plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt | TurboFry 4-in-1 ...)

evidence_observations.observation: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B04G1MEwY , https://www.amazon.com/dp/B02NbDxp3 and https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00hJ57DV each returned Amazon's "Sorry! We couldn't find that page" error page on 2026-11-13.
evidence_observations.interpretation: No catalog record exists for any of the three tokens as given.

evidence_observations.observation: Each token was measured against the ASIN identifier definition (10 characters): B04G1MEwY=9, B02NbDxp3=9, B00hJ57DV=9. Each is alphanumeric, so only the length fails.
evidence_observations.interpretation: Pattern is consistent with a one-character truncation, but the missing character is not recoverable and was NOT guessed.
